email.body1:
Brandon, saw VitalEdge launch the VitalityAI agentic suite and bring on a new CRO.

New product and new revenue leadership usually mean buying signals pile up faster than the team can act on them, and slow signal-to-action is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns a signal into a researched, written, followed-up touch with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for VitalEdge off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brandon, quick follow-up for VitalEdge.

With new revenue leadership setting targets, the lift from outbound has to be measurable, but data hygiene and follow-up speed make that hard. The fix is making each signal trigger a touch automatically and tracking what it returns.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Brandon, last bit of proof for VitalEdge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VitalEdge's reply rate likely compares to other dealer-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revops motion? I'll tailor it to VitalEdge either way.
